FunctionOutput_salescaptain_removetagfro.description: Removed tag assignment and its related contact and tag.

tags.instructions: Use companyId from `list-companies`, contactId from `list-contacts`, and tagId from `list-tags`. Use `get-contact` to inspect tag names. This removes only the association; use `delete-tag-permanently` to delete the tag itself. `add-tag-to-contact` can assign it again.

functions.name: reply-conversation
functions.description: Send an outbound text response in an existing company conversation, optionally using an SMS template.

text.description: Ordinary plain-text body; preserved exactly, including Unicode and whitespace. Required even with a template.

companyId.description: Company containing the conversation and determining the sender account.

templateId.description: Optional SMS template identifier; omitted sends without template selection.

conversationId.description: Existing conversation whose contact and channel receive the response.

FunctionInput_salescaptain_replyconversa.description: Text response and optional template selection for an existing company conversation.

id.description: Chat-service message identifier returned after sending; may have different syntax from read-message IDs.

isMe.description: Whether the authenticated account sent the message.

text.description: Message body returned by the chat service.

author.description: Display name of the message author.

messageType.description: Channel/type returned by the chat service; not constrained to a guessed closed set.

sentByUsername.description: Sender username returned by the chat service.

FunctionOutput_salescaptain_replyconvers.description: Chat-service acknowledgment of a sent message; not proof of recipient delivery.

tags.instructions: Use companyId from `list-companies` and conversationId from `list-conversations` or `create-contact`. Check `get-conversation` and `list-messages` for recipient/channel context. Optional template IDs come from `list-sms-templates`; text is still required. This sends to the conversation's existing contact, not arbitrary recipients. A successful result does not prove delivery. Never blindly retry an uncertain send; inspect `list-messages` first.

functions.name: update-contact
functions.description: Partially update a company contact's name, email, phone, or selected custom-field values. Requires the contacts access role.

name.description: Replacement full name; omitted leaves it unchanged; cannot be cleared.

email.description: Replacement email, or null to remove it; omitted leaves unchanged.

phone.description: Replacement phone, or null to remove it; omitted leaves unchanged.

companyId.description: Company that owns the contact.

customFields.description: Values to set for specified custom-field IDs; omitted leaves all unchanged. Not a complete replacement.

value.description: New stored string value, including empty string; no custom-field deletion is promised.

items.description: A custom-field identifier and the string value to store.

name.description: Replacement full name; omitted leaves it unchanged; cannot be cleared.

email.description: Replacement email, or null to remove it; omitted leaves unchanged.

phone.description: Replacement phone, or null to remove it; omitted leaves unchanged.

customFields.description: Values to set for specified custom-field IDs; omitted leaves all unchanged. Not a complete replacement.

tags.description: Associated tag names; omitted if absent.

items.description: An associated tag name.

email.description: Stored email or null; omitted if absent.

phone.description: Stored phone or null; omitted if absent.

createdAt.description: Creation instant in UTC; omitted if absent.

updatedAt.description: Last update instant in UTC or null; omitted if absent.

tags.instructions: Obtain contactId with `list-contacts` and field IDs with `list-custom-fields`. Omit fields to leave them unchanged. Set email or phone to null to remove it. Custom fields update only the supplied IDs, not the whole contact. Use `create-contact` for a new contact.
